title: Charge Air Temperature High Torque Derate
detail_of_failure: The temperature signal from the boot pressure and temperature sensor exceeds the upper control limit.
controller_action: Operates the machine with the engine output limited.
related_information: • Boost temperature can be checked with monitoring function. (Code: 18500) • After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Start the engine.

steps.procedure: Cooling performance of the aftercooler can be lowered. Check it for the items that follow. • Loosened or damaged fan belt • Insufficient cooling air volume • Clogged aftercooler fin
It is possible that there is an abnormal temperature rise of the turbocharger outlet. Check the related parts.
Do the troubleshooting for failure codes [CA153] and [CA154].
